=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:5877-5898,6037-6040 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When `AI_COMMENT_SIGNING_SECRET` is set, the `rb-judge-security-hold:v1` marker is posted through the `gh` signing shim. The shim posts it as `github-actions[bot]` and appends a `<!-- ai-comment-sig:v1 ... -->` line. The dedupe read goes through raw `curl_gh_api` (`_tg_newest_comments_json`), so both `tg_trusted($login)` (which expects the PAT login) and `endswith("\n" + $marker)` reject the marker, and `rb_security_hold_count` is always 0.
  WHY: Every judge round on a held head logs `repeat=false level=CRITICAL`, pages again and posts one more marker comment, so the issue #9942 goal "fires once per head SHA" is not met and comments pile up. No test sets the secret. All reviewers rated it MAJOR (mapped to high).
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:5880-5882 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The dedupe reads only the newest page of up to 100 PR comments (scripts/tg_helpers.sh:461-475, `last_page=(total + 99) / 100`). When the comment count crosses a multiple of 100, or 100 or more comments arrive after the marker, the marker is no longer seen.
  WHY: A later held round sees count=0, pages CRITICAL again and posts another marker, which breaks the "once per head" guarantee on long-stuck PRs such as #9283. Severity disagreement: MAJOR from gemini, minimax and glm; NIT from sonnet and luna. The highest (MAJOR, mapped to high) is used.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:6034-6040 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The marker is posted even when the Telegram page was not delivered. `tg_send_msg` prints an empty id on failure, or prints nothing when the secret or chat id is missing, and `tg_send_tracked` / `tg_store_msg_id` still return 0.
  WHY: A Telegram 5xx, timeout or 429 on the first `exhausted_without_completed_audit` round still records the marker. Every later round then drops to DEBUG, so the CRITICAL "needs a human" page is lost for the life of that head. That is worse than the old behaviour. Sonnet rated it MAJOR (mapped to high).
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:6038 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The marker text says "a new push or /re-run starts over", but the dedupe is keyed only on the head SHA, so a /re-run on the same head that stays held does not page again.
  WHY: An operator who runs /re-run expects a fresh page if the head stays stuck and gets none, and the gate's own comment says "/re-run rechecks this head". Sonnet rated it NIT (mapped to low). glm raised the same point as a hardening suggestion only.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:431-521 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The widened `single_pass_audit_runs` listing still fetches one repo-wide page of 100 runs. Marker windows older than the returned page are classified "unknown" by `single_pass_marker_audit_lost` (lines 509-510) and counted as attempts.
  WHY: This fails closed as specified and keeps the single API call (AD-1 option B), but in busy repos it makes the lost-audit retry budget less effective and can still reach `exhausted_without_completed_audit`. All three rated it NIT (mapped to low).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

(No task gaps reported.)

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:Step "Telegram review-blocked judge decision". Line 6034 calls `tg_send_tracked "${PR_NUMBER}" "${MSG}" "${JUDGE_ALERT_LEVEL}"`. Lines 6037-6040 then post the marker whenever `[ -n "${RB_SECURITY_HOLD_MARKER:-}" ] && [ "${RB_SECURITY_HOLD_REPEAT:-}" != "true" ]`. | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The marker is posted with no check that the page went out. `tg_send_msg` prints an empty id when the send fails, or prints nothing and returns 0 when the secret or chat id is missing, and `tg_send_tracked` returns 0 (scripts/tg_helpers.sh lines 535-537, 589-595, 141-143, 156-160).
  WHY: When the first held round hits a Telegram error, the marker is still posted, every later round drops to DEBUG, and the CRITICAL page is lost for that head. Suggested fix: call `tg_send_msg` directly, store the id, and post the marker only when the id is non-empty.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:The step env sets `AI_COMMENT_SIGNING_SECRET` and `AI_COMMENT_JOB_TOKEN` (lines 5807-5808). Line 5822 runs `source "${SUPPORT_SCRIPTS_DIR}/gh_helpers.sh"`. Marker POST line 6039; read lines 5880-5882 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The signing shim (scripts/gh_helpers.sh line 958, lines 122-142; scripts/comment_signature.py lines 551-595) posts the marker as `github-actions[bot]` with a trailing sig line. The raw `curl_gh_api` read (scripts/tg_helpers.sh lines 461-475) fails both `tg_trusted` and `endswith`.
  WHY: With the secret set, `rb_security_hold_count` is always 0, so every round pages CRITICAL and posts another marker. Suggested fix: post with raw curl and the PAT, as `_tg_tracking_write` does. The #9249 crash marker in scripts/review_autofix_step_post_review_blocked_comment.sh (lines 141-160) has the same latent issue.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:Line 5880, `rb_security_hold_comments="$(_tg_newest_comments_json "${PR_NUMBER}")"`. In scripts/tg_helpers.sh, lines 470-474 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The dedupe looks only at the newest page of up to 100 comments, so the marker drops out of view when the count crosses a multiple of 100.
  WHY: Each crossing causes one extra CRITICAL page and one more marker. The #9249 crash marker has the same limit.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:Line 6038 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The marker text "a new push or /re-run starts over" is wrong, because a /re-run on the same head stays at DEBUG.
  WHY: Operators expect a fresh page and get none. Suggested text: "a new push starts over; /re-run rechecks this head without paging again".
- TASK COMPLETENESS / INTENT GAPS: NONE. All deliverables of issue #9942 are present. The files_touched entries scripts/review_autofix_step_post_review_blocked_comment.sh and tests/test_review_rb_judge_security_pass.py are not required by any goal or step.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS (3 related items):
  - lines 6034-6040: post the marker only when the msg id is non-empty.
  - line 6039: post with `curl_gh_api` and the PAT instead of `gh api`.
  - The step's run body grows by about 4 KB against the 18,000-character test cap in tests/test_workflow_file_size_limit.py: run that test and, if the body is over the cap, move the dedupe block into a `scripts/review_autofix_step_*.sh` helper.
  HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
